task: Diagnose resource pressure on this self-hosted Codex runner without modifying the repository or accessing production. Report: runner name and hostname; nproc and lscpu summary; free -h and /proc/meminfo key values; uptime/load averages; cgroup v1/v2 CPU and memory limits/current usage if available; /proc/pressure/cpu, /proc/pressure/memory, and /proc/pressure/io if available; df -h and df -i for the workspace filesystem; top memory/CPU processes (sanitise command lines if they could expose secrets); whether this runner appears to be inside a Docker/container environment; recent OOM-kill/kernel memory-pressure evidence if readable without privilege (dmesg/journalctl may fail and that is fine); and any obvious evidence of throttling or oversubscription. Do not print environment variables, tokens, credentials, or production data. Do not modify files. End with a concise assessment of whether resource pressure could plausibly explain intermittent Codex timeouts and identify any evidence that cannot be observed from inside this runner container.
